This is extremely important, because it gives these guys a very powerful defense against any charge of journalistic misconduct: They simply have to say "we are not journalists, we are humor writers". this has been called, in journalism circles, the "John Stewart defense", and has the 1st amendment on its side.

In the case of kotaku and polygon, it would be a good defense. Look at the titles of their articles, look at what they are based on. look at what they are saying. they can argue, and probably win, that they should never have been taken seriously from the beginning.

This is an important thing to consider, because this gives the journos a very good defense to our accusations of unethical journalism. I can not stress this enough.
